speaker: TOMKIN
text: Forward! The sea shall know our courage!

speaker: PENNY
text: That is definitely not a seagull.

speaker: TOMKIN
text: Then it shall answer to the Captain!

speaker: PENNY
text: You saved us with a butter tub.

speaker: TOMKIN
text: The Butter Tub Protocol. Patent pending.

speaker: PENNY
text: That glow is coming from below.

speaker: TOMKIN
text: Halt, crustacean! This is a private lighthouse!

speaker: PENNY
text: Ground wire's live. Keep clear, Captain!

speaker: TOMKIN
text: My tub! The sea returns what is rightfully mine.

speaker: RADIO
text: Lighthouse, this is the Marigold! Your light's out. We can't see the rocks!

speaker: TOMKIN
text: By order of the Captain, Operation Bright Lantern begins now!

speaker: PENNY
text: There's an old power room under the tower.

speaker: TOMKIN
text: Two hundred and twelve steps. I am counting.

speaker: HERO
text: Whatever made these, it's been here before.

speaker: HERO
text: Did the tunnel just answer you?

speaker: PENNY
text: Someone's rewired the old signal room.

speaker: PENNY
text: The drones aren't attacking the lantern. They're switching it off.

speaker: KEEPER
text: If the light ever goes dark, the machine beneath the sea will wake. Keep it burning.

speaker: TOMKIN
text: And the boat. And the honour of my tub.

speaker: RADIO
text: Lighthouse, we're drifting closer. Is anyone there?

speaker: TOMKIN
text: Do not look down. Do not look down. I looked down.

speaker: TOMKIN
text: And that is how it's done.

speaker: PENNY
text: Let's see what's wrong with you.

speaker: PENNY
text: The main drive gear. Someone's taken it.

speaker: PENNY
text: The drone's gear... nearly the right size.

speaker: PENNY
text: It's slipping. It needs a spacer.

speaker: TOMKIN
text: Behold. The Butter Tub Protocol, part two.

speaker: TOMKIN
text: Nobody said anything about wet paws!

speaker: PENNY
text: I'm okay! I'll get it open!

speaker: PENNY
text: That's not ours. Something's tapped into the generator.

speaker: PENNY
text: It's stealing our power. So we send it all back, through the beacon.

speaker: PENNY
text: Gloves on. Bus off. Swap it over...

speaker: TOMKIN
text: None shall pass! Not you. Not you either.

speaker: PENNY
text: The grounding strap's snapped! I need a cable!

speaker: PENNY
text: If this gear slips, we lose the light!

speaker: PENNY
text: There, its receiver! Aim the beam there!

speaker: RADIO
text: Lighthouse, we can see the channel. Thank you!

speaker: RADIO
text: You saved my whole crew. We'll bring you fish on Sunday!

speaker: PENNY
text: For bravery. And for the tub.
